name: Chau Doc
provinceNote: Provincial pages in 2026 still use An Giang for the province after the merger with Kiên Giang. The contact line is in phường Rạch Giá. The base here is Châu Đốc only.
dotReason: Worth a night when the Hậu river and Sam Mountain are the trip.
summary: A Mekong Delta river town on the Hau River, known for floating fish farms and the temples of Sam Mountain. Visit the fish rafts, the Ba Chua Xu temple and the Cham villages, browse the fermented-fish stalls at the market, and eat turmeric fish noodle soup. Two days suits travellers interested in faith, river life and food.
fee: Trà Sư, applied from 1 November 2024: gate 120,000 VND; motorboat 60,000 VND; rowboat 60,000 VND. A 30 June 2026 price-notice title is also published — confirm the boat at the gate. Temple gates, town-boat fare, and cable car: Check on arrival. Bún cá: average 20,000 VND, and 10,000 VND away from the center; also given as 10,000–20,000 VND (2 Oct 2019). 25,000–30,000 VND, not counting sides (20 Oct 2023). Other stall prices: Check on arrival.
getThere: About 3 hours by car from Can Tho Airport. Ho Chi Minh City: about 5 hours on the English page, about 6 hours on the Vietnamese page. Sam Mountain: about 5 km and about 7 km. Minutes: Check on arrival. The mountain is in phường Vĩnh Tế, not inside the Châu Đốc town ward. Bus station: Quốc lộ 91 bypass, Khóm Hòa Bình, phường Châu Đốc. Office hours 07:00–11:00 and 13:00–17:00, not a departure board. Coach times: Check on arrival. No rail station was recorded. Luxury cruises between Can Tho and Châu Đốc, and from Cambodia: operator, pier, and clock Check on arrival. Minutes from the river hotels to the Tịnh Biên or Vĩnh Xương gates: Check on arrival. Chợ Châu Đốc: 05:30–18:00 every day (VnExpress, 20 Oct 2023). Vietnam Tourism: no clock. Fish rafts: 165 rafts in six color blocks (early-2024 color project); more than 160, and also 161, over more than 1 km, beside Cồn Tiên bridge. Last-boat clock: Check on arrival. Trà Sư: 23 km out. Area more than 845 ha, and 850 ha. Bamboo bridge 2.2 km, and longer than 3,800 m. Vía Bà Chúa Xứ: 22nd to the 27th of the fourth lunar month, and 23rd to the 27th. In 2026 the ward mapped the rites to 6–12 June. Another year’s civil dates: Check on arrival. Minutes from a bungalow on Núi Sam to the river walk: Check on arrival.
bestMonths: September to November for high water
seoTitle: Chau Doc travel guide — Sam Mountain, Ba Chua Xu, Tra Su, fish rafts
seoDescription: Sleep by the Hậu for the fish rafts and Sam Mountain. Visit Ba Chua Xu, boat through Tra Su, and eat bún cá at the market.
intro: The picture is the Hậu at Châu Đốc: olive water, a boat, and fish-raft houses along a green bank. Núi Sam sits just inland in phường Vĩnh Tế. Sleep in a river room in phường Châu Đốc, or in a bungalow on the hill if you want the plain in the morning. The ward office is at 10 Lê Lợi. That ward was formed from Vĩnh Nguơn, Châu Phú A, Châu Phú B, Vĩnh Mỹ, and part of Vĩnh Châu.

Can Tho is the night you choose when Cái Răng at dawn is the point, and it is where you land if you fly. Châu Đốc is the night you choose for the border river, the fish farms, Châu Phong and Đa Phước, and the temple cluster at the foot of the hill. A same-day drive from Ho Chi Minh City is the journey, not the start of a dawn boat.
Use one day for the market, a boat among the rafts or across to the Cham bank, and the halls at Núi Sam. Keep Trà Sư, 23 km out, for its own half day. The evening is the riverbank.
gettingAround: Boats are ordinary transport between the bank, the islets, and the fish rafts. Sam Mountain is a short road from the river wards, in phường Vĩnh Tế. The bus station is on the Quốc lộ 91 bypass, Khóm Hòa Bình, phường Châu Đốc. The station office is open 07:00–11:00 and 13:00–17:00. Those are office hours, not a departure board. Luxury cruises between Can Tho and Châu Đốc, and from Cambodia, are named.

stayAreas.name: Phường Châu Đốc river
stayAreas.summary: Small hotels along the Châu Đốc river, so the evening walk is the bank.

stayAreas.name: Núi Sam, phường Vĩnh Tế
stayAreas.summary: A bungalow on the hill if you want the plain in the morning. The 2026 festival opened here.

eat: Breakfast is bún cá at the edge of Chợ Châu Đốc, a fish-noodle soup with turmeric and crunchy điên điển flowers. Season it with chili and lime. Mắm, fish pickled with palm sugar, salt, chili, and garlic, is stacked in the market.

Dinner is lẩu mắm, the shared pot to order before you leave, and cá kho tộ, a Mekong claypot fish eaten with rice and greens. A separate seafood hotpot is also on the table. Afternoon sweets are bánh bò thốt nốt, bánh bò Chăm in the villages, and chè thốt nốt.
interestsBody: Dining is bún cá and mắm at Chợ Châu Đốc, then lẩu mắm and cá kho tộ, with palm sweets beside them.
Sam Mountain, Trà Sư, the fish rafts, and the Cham villages are how you use the town. Long Xuyen, Ba Chuc, Oc Eo – Ba The, and Tinh Bien and Nui Cam are side trips.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: Market breakfast, mắm, and claypot fish.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Bún cá at Chợ Châu Đốc, mắm in the aisles, and cá kho tộ with rice.

interestGroups.title: Sam Mountain pilgrimage
interestGroups.summary: One morning in phường Vĩnh Tế for the hill, the shrine, Tây An, the cave pagoda, and the tomb.
body: About 200 large and small religious sites are scattered on the slopes. The foot of the hill is Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ, Chùa Tây An, Chùa Hang (Phước Điền), and Lăng Thoại Ngọc Hầu.
The climb, and any cable car, is a different effort from those halls. From the first lunar month through the Via festival, the halls are crowded from early morning.

cards.title: Sam Mountain
cards.summary: The sacred hill in phường Vĩnh Tế. Walk the halls at the foot, then climb if you want the plain. The distance is given as about 5 km and about 7 km.

cards.title: Ba Chua Xu Temple
cards.summary: Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ at the foot of the hill. Offerings on the steps, and the statue found on the mountain about 200 years ago. Come early outside festival days.

cards.title: Tay An Pagoda
cards.summary: Chùa Tây An, on the same foot-of-the-hill walk as the shrine and the tomb. The visit is the facade and the garden of stupas.

cards.title: Cave Pagoda
cards.summary: Chùa Hang, also called Phước Điền, on the slope. It is a climb, and the view from it reaches toward the plain.

cards.title: Thoai Ngoc Hau Tomb
cards.summary: Lăng Thoại Ngọc Hầu at the mountain, not at the market. The 2026 festival moves his spirit tablet between this ground and the shrine.

interestGroups.title: Tra Su by boat
interestGroups.summary: The flooded cajuput forest 23 km out. The gate ticket does not include the boat.
body: Rừng tràm Trà Sư is a wetland conservation forest west of the Hậu. The area is given as more than 845 ha and as 850 ha. The bamboo bridge is given as 2.2 km and as longer than 3,800 m.
The standing price, applied from 1 November 2024, is 120,000 VND at the gate and 60,000 VND for a motorboat or a rowboat. Confirm the boat at the gate.

cards.title: Tra Su cajuput forest
cards.summary: A half day, 23 km from town. Walk the bamboo bridge and take a sampan through duckweed. The gate is 120,000 VND. The boat is a separate ticket.

interestGroups.title: Fish rafts on the Hau
interestGroups.summary: Raft houses that are freshwater fish farms, at the Châu Đốc river junction.
body: The community is about 50 years old, raising catfish and snapper. The rafts are given as 165 in six color blocks, as more than 160, and as 161, over more than 1 km beside Cồn Tiên bridge.
This is not Cái Răng. Lights come on after dark.

cards.title: Fish-raft village
cards.summary: Boat among the raft houses on the Hậu and the Châu Đốc river. The counts are 165, more than 160, and 161.

interestGroups.title: Cham weaving villages
interestGroups.summary: Châu Phong and Đa Phước, on two banks of the Hậu. Mubarak is Châu Phong.
body: Mubarak, Jamiul Azhar, and Nia’mah are in Châu Phong. Ihsan and Sunnah are in Đa Phước. Weaving in Châu Phong was listed as national intangible cultural heritage at the end of 2023, with lifecycle rituals.
Châu Giang and Châu Phong are also described as two islets. Keep Châu Giang as that older name, and do not merge it into one building with Châu Phong.

cards.title: Chau Phong and Da Phuoc
cards.summary: Mosques, stilt houses, and weaving across the river. The photograph is the Jamiul Azhar gate in Châu Phong.

interestGroups.title: River evening
interestGroups.summary: Walk the Hậu bank after the mountain.
body: The evening is this waterfront: barges, the far islets, and the rafts once the lights are on. The walk is not a ticket.
Festival nights at Núi Sam are a separate calendar. They are not this walk.

cards.title: Hau riverfront
cards.summary: The town bank in phường Châu Đốc at dusk. Stay on the river if you want to walk here.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: Chợ Châu Đốc for mắm, dried fish, and the morning bowl.

blocks.heading: Chợ Châu Đốc
paragraphs: The hall is the morning: noodle bowls, sugarcane juice, flowers on the pavement, and stacks of mắm. Fish pickled with palm sugar, salt, chili, and garlic fills the aisles. Khô cá, khô bò, and đường thốt nốt are the gifts to carry home. Come just after sunrise, before you head for the hill.

cards.title: Chau Doc Market
cards.summary: Mắm stacked in the aisles, bún cá at the edge of the hall, and sugarcane juice just after sunrise.

faqs.q: Is a day trip from Ho Chi Minh City enough?
faqs.a: No, if you wanted a boat. The drive is about five hours, and also about six hours. Sleep in Châu Đốc, or in Can Tho if the dawn market there is the point.

faqs.q: When is the festival of Ba Chua Xu?
faqs.a: It falls in the fourth lunar month, on the 22nd to the 27th, and also on the 23rd to the 27th. In 2026 the ward mapped the rites to 6–12 June.

faqs.q: Should you stay in Can Tho or Chau Doc?
faqs.a: Stay in Can Tho for Cái Răng at dawn and for the airport. Stay in Châu Đốc for the fish rafts, the Cham villages, and Núi Sam. The airport drive between them is about three hours.

season.label: High water Aug–Nov
season.note: The rainy season is given as May to November, with the best visit in September to November, when floodwater fills Trà Sư. It is also given as rain from May through October, high water from August to November, and dry, sunny weather from November to April. Flood is the reason to be on the water.
